messages.subject: Posterior of variance ratio
parts:
Hi,

what is the easiest way to obtain the posterior for a ratio of variance components, i.e. r = VAR(x1)/(VAR(x1)+VAR(x2))?

formula = y ~ 1+f(x1,model="iid")+f(x2,model="iid")
mod = inla(formula,data=data,family="gaussian")

Best,

Patrik Waldmann
